h1: Custom Wood Badges for Unique Branding
metaDescription: Order custom wood badges for a natural, eco-friendly look. Perfect for events and employee recognition. Start your order today.
introHtml: Wood badges offer a natural, warm aesthetic that stands out from standard metal or plastic options. They are ideal for eco-conscious brands, outdoor events, or rustic-themed recognition programs. Laser engraving on wood creates a crisp, lasting impression without the need for ink or dyes. Choose from maple, walnut, or cherry finishes to match your brand's tone. Whether for trade shows or staff awards, custom wood badges convey authenticity and craftsmanship.
heroAltText: Custom wood badges with laser-engraved text and logo, displayed on a wooden surface
